entities.summary: The Inter-American Defense Board (IADB) is an international defense institution of the Organization of American States, headquartered in Washington, D.C. The IADB is an international committee of nationally appointed defense officials who develop collaborative approaches on common defense and security issues facing countries in North, Central, and South America.
